text: What is the primary benefit of data compression techniques?
choices: To reduce storage space and transmission time
explanation: These techniques allow us to reduce the amount of memory and disk space required to store the information and transfer large files faster.

text: In the context of Linux systems, what does 'tar' stand for?
explanation: On Linux systems, tar (tape archiver) is the most common archive format.

text: Which application is used to combine many files into a single archive file on Linux?
explanation: Archive Manager permits us to combine many files or an entire directory tree into a single file known as an archive.

text: Data compression generally works by identifying and eliminating what?
explanation: Data compression generally works by identifying repetition in the data and encoding the data in a way that reduces or eliminates such repetition.

text: What does VLC stand for in 'VLC media player'?
explanation: We have discussed earlier that Ubuntu comes with built-in tools... VideoLAN Client (VLC) media player is shown in figure 13.3.

text: Which menu in VLC media player allows you to convert multimedia files from one format to another?
explanation: After starting VLC from the Applications, we may open one or more files using the Media -> Open File... or Convert / Save option from the menu.

text: Google Maps is a free internet-based service provided by Google for:
choices: Viewing maps, satellite imagery, and directions
explanation: Google Maps... has over a period of years, collected extensive map data... satellite imagery, cars with cameras... directions.

text: Which view in Google Maps displays actual photographs of the earth?
explanation: By clicking on the Satellite button, we may switch to the satellite image view, shown in figure 13.5.

text: R is a free software environment used primarily for:
explanation: R is a free software environment for statistical computing. It is a GNU project....

text: Which command is used to start the R software from the terminal?
explanation: To invoke the R scripts from terminal window, open terminal and type R on the command prompt.

text: In R software, which function is used to draw a bar chart?
explanation: We may use the function barplot with various arguments for drawing the plot as shown in figure 13.12.

text: Which symbol is used to define a list of values in R?
explanation: In R, lists are defined using 'c'. Example: no_students <- c(140, 210, 700...).

text: Is the R language case-sensitive?
explanation: It has its own scripting language. It is a case-sensitive language.

text: Which tool is used to enter Unicode characters (like Gujarati or Hindi) into an application?
explanation: The Character Map program... can be used to enter Unicode characters into any application... like the long 'II' in Gujarati.

text: RationalPlan is an open-source software used for:
explanation: RationalPlan is an open source software designed to assist project managers in preparing, maintaining and following a well defined project plan.

text: Which version of RationalPlan is designed to manage independent projects?
explanation: RationalPlan Single allows us to manage independent projects that do not have common resources.

text: Skype allows users to communicate using:
explanation: The Skype service allows users to communicate with peers using voice, video as well as text.

text: What type of file extension is commonly used for archives in Linux?
explanation: The most common compressed file formats are the zip file format and the tar.gz file format.

text: In the R command `barplot`, what does the `xlab` argument specify?
explanation: We use the arguments... xlab to specify X-axis label.

text: Which function in R is used to produce a histogram?
explanation: The histogram can be drawn using the code shown in figure 13.14 (code snippet shows `hist(marks, col="lightblue")`).

text: What allows VLC to support many different audio and video formats?
choices: It uses the internet to play files
It has a modular design with many codecs
It converts everything to MP3 first
explanation: Each multimedia data format requires its own codec. The advantage of VLC is that it supports all the popular codecs and hence all the popular formats.

text: Can Google Maps provide turn-by-turn guidance?
choices: No, it only shows static maps
Yes, using GPS on mobile devices
explanation: The service even provides turn-by-turn guidance while traveling if we use a mobile device equipped with GPS receiver.

text: In RationalPlan, which product is used to manage interdependent projects sharing resources?
explanation: RationalPlan Multi allows us to manage projects that share company resources... It includes all features of RationalPlan Single.

text: Which software is proprietary and not available for modification (unlike R or RationalPlan)?
explanation: The Skype software can be downloaded free of cost, though its source code is proprietary and not available for modification.

text: What prompt does R issue if a command is incomplete when you press ENTER?
explanation: Observe that for long commands, when we press ENTER before the command is complete, R issues the + prompt until we complete the command.

text: To create a playlist in VLC, which view option is used?
explanation: The playlist for playing the same tracks again... using the View -> Playlist option.

text: What does the `names.arg` argument do in the `barplot` function?
choices: Sets the name of the file
Sets the labels for the bars
Sets the title of the graph
Sets the color of the bars
explanation: names.arg to specify... the values to be displayed for the bars (e.g., faculty names).

text: Which operating system comes with Archive Manager by default?
explanation: There is no menu item to start the archive manager by default... This will create a new archive... with that file or directory as its contents. (Context: Ubuntu/Linux mentioned throughout chapter).

text: What allows Skype to call traditional telephone networks?
choices: Using Skype Credit / Debit based user account
explanation: The calls to landline telephones or mobile phones are charged via a debit based user account system....

text: How do you copy a character from Character Map to your document?
explanation: We first select the script... double click characters to insert them into the Text to copy area... After we get a substantial amount of content, we may copy the content and paste into an application.
